game_start.intro: The game begins. Trump suit: {trump_suit} (trump card: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mchezaji {player_id} katika Whist ya Kijerumani.
〕{phase_info}
Ushikiliaje {hand_size} kadi.
Cheza kadi kwa '〕[play N]', ambapo N ni nafasi yake katika mkono wako (kwa mfano '〕[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.deck_empty: Chimbunga chili cha kama - kakuli kaarte.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kuzachisa "[play N]" hanga ulizange kaarte wa Nth mu mukono we.
invalid_move.bad_position: That card position does not exist. You hold {hand_size} cards.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: You must follow suit and play a {lead_suit} card.

trick.won_learning: Player {winner_id} wins the trick with {card} and takes the face-up card.

phase.learning_complete: The deck is exhausted. The learning phase is over - every remaining trick counts towards victory.

draw.winner_received: Yena wahasa mu chilimba ni kutambula {card}.
draw.loser_received: You lost the trick and drew {card} from the deck.

turn.scores_learning: Mafungu yaliyopatikana hadi sasa - Mchezaji 0: {tricks0}, Mchezaji 1: {tricks1}

trick_view.empty: Kukushi ni umwe yoze makazangalisa mu kalimbalaka.
trick_view.trump_indicator: (TRUMP) Yuma yize yinalingiwa ha miaka yino.
